changelog:
v4.2.9 — Fixes repeated buffering on movies and series

• Fixes movies and shows buffering over and over even on a fast connection. After the app switched audio or video decoders mid-title it was quietly cutting its own buffer in half, so it kept running dry. It now keeps the full buffer your device is capable of.

• Fixes the app getting stuck on the loading spinner forever when a stream stops responding. It now notices within about 20 seconds, reconnects automatically, and only shows an error if reconnecting genuinely doesn't work.

• The Stats screen now works during playback again — it was going blank after a decoder switch. It also shows your real measured network speed and a rebuffer counter, so buffering problems are much easier to pin down.

Includes all v4.2.7-4.2.8 (freeze/ANR, 4K binge) and v4.2.4-4.2.6 (4K, Dolby Vision, Dolby audio) fixes.
